name: Tsutsumi Tango
source:
High school student. Fond of Yuyu. Straightforward.

[Spoiler]His true identity is "Inose Omega," the 24th Ψ-clone, who goes by the alias Tsutsumi Tango while in World A. He is a high-ranking member of Liminality, and the one in charge of the Second Eclipse Project[/spoiler]
